name: reference-cpp
description: The project's built-in RocketFlyByWire wrapped in the C ABI. The baseline every submission is trying to beat.
author: rocketfight
note: Submitted as a prebuilt binary, not as source, and that is the one way this example is unlike a real submission. flybywire.cpp includes control/RocketFlyByWire.hpp and links rf_control -- it reaches into src/, which the server's compiler deliberately cannot see (it passes only -I include). So it is built by this repository's own CMake and uploaded as the resulting .so. It is a baseline to beat, not a template to copy; start from examples/submissions/simple_c instead.
